verdictEs: Windrose Mod Manager (CertiFried) si gestionas un dedicated server remoto via SFTP/FTP o quieres feature set completo con UI estructurada para configs. Vercadi Mod Manager si solo necesitas instalar mods en cliente, prefieres código open source auditable y aceptas scope reducido.
verdictEn: Windrose Mod Manager (CertiFried) if you manage a remote dedicated server via SFTP/FTP or want a complete feature set with structured UI for configs. Vercadi Mod Manager if you only need to install mods on the client, prefer auditable open-source code, and accept the reduced scope.

useCases.labelEs: Solo cliente single-player con 5-10 mods QoL
useCases.reasonEs: Vercadi cubre exactamente este caso sin overhead. CertiFried tiene features que no vas a usar (SFTP, server config) que solo agregan complejidad para tu use case.
useCases.reasonEn: Vercadi covers exactly this case without overhead. CertiFried has features you won't use (SFTP, server config) that just add complexity for your use case.

useCases.labelEs: Gestionar dedicated server remoto hosted en g-portal o low.ms
useCases.labelEn: Manage remote dedicated server hosted on g-portal or low.ms
useCases.reasonEs: CertiFried tiene soporte nativo de SFTP/FTP para deploy de mods al server remoto. Vercadi no maneja remote — quedas haciendo upload manual via FileZilla, lo cual mata el value-add del manager.
useCases.reasonEn: CertiFried has native SFTP/FTP support to deploy mods to the remote server. Vercadi doesn't handle remote — you'd be doing manual upload via FileZilla, which kills the manager's value-add.

useCases.labelEs: Auditar el código del manager antes de darle filesystem/network access
useCases.labelEn: Audit the manager code before granting filesystem/network access
useCases.reasonEs: Vercadi está open source en GitHub — lees exactamente qué hace antes de instalarlo. CertiFried es closed source: hay que confiar en el author sin verification.
useCases.reasonEn: Vercadi is open source on GitHub — you read exactly what it does before installing. CertiFried is closed source: you have to trust the author without verification.

useCases.reasonEs: CertiFried tiene UI estructurada para los configs JSON — menos riesgo de typos que rompen el server. Vercadi también edita configs pero con UI más simple, menos guardrails.
useCases.reasonEn: CertiFried has structured UI for JSON configs — less risk of typos that break the server. Vercadi also edits configs but with a simpler UI, fewer guardrails.

useCases.labelEs: Forkear o contribuir al manager para customizar features
useCases.labelEn: Fork or contribute to the manager to customize features
useCases.reasonEs: El repo de Vercadi acepta PRs y issues públicos. CertiFried no tiene este pathway — el author decide unilateralmente el roadmap.
useCases.reasonEn: Vercadi's repo accepts public PRs and issues. CertiFried has no such pathway — the author unilaterally decides the roadmap.
